concerns.text: FR-013 requires the use of the verified open‑access EDS dataset “Doe et al., 2023, Open Perovskite EDS Repository”. The plan explicitly marks FR‑013 as **Not satisfied** and provides no alternative data source or mitigation, leaving the functional requirement unaddressed.

FR‑001 includes an amendment that if fewer than 10 usable samples are obtained, the system must still perform descriptive analysis and generate a preliminary report without formal hypothesis testing. The plan’s mapping table and narrative do not mention this < 10‑sample fallback, only handling missing EDS maps and < 30‑sample power issues, so the amendment is not covered.
